fit_notes: Speeds are normalized by each event's top10 max speed.
Capacity uses each event/tier observed max and q99.5 as lower-bound evidence, then enforces a monotone rank envelope.
Cruise and idle are fit per event before cross-event quantiles, so activity-specific intensity remains visible.
Rank interpolation is only used for profile priors; observed cutoff surface modeling still keeps API tiers exact.
progress_fraction is score_at_progress / final_score for each event and tier.
Use this as a player expectation prior for final cutoff, not as direct future leakage.
